svg.title: Diagram: one note, three readers
svg.desc: A hand-drawn notebook diagram with one note at the centre, read three ways: by a person inside the app, by anyone with a text editor, and by a future agent. Two note cards record the app's computed layer and what a copy of the files actually contained.

text.tspan: what the app adds to a file a person can already read
Read on one copy: four notes, desktop release 1.8.9, 1 November 2026.
No agent was run against it. The right-hand reader is the question, not a result.
